title: fix(spec): break the eager import cycle that crashed /api and /data under OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS=1
body:
Fixes #19930
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

`OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS=1` is the documented emergency rollback of the lazy-schema memory optimization (`content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx:30`). With it set, a process whose first spec import was `@objectstack/spec/api` or `@objectstack/spec/data` threw at import. The default lazy path was not affected.

## Measured before changing anything (`origin/main` `fdeeea0cc9`)

- **Load chain**, taken with a `Module._load` hook on the source entry: `src/data/index.ts` → `data/query.zod.ts` → `data/filter.zod.ts` → `shared/strict-object.ts` → `shared/suggestions.zod.ts` → `data/field.zod.ts`. The throw is `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'FilterConditionSchema' before initialization` at `field.zod.ts:1529` (`relatedListFilter`), reached through the eager `lazySchema` at `:1000`. PM mechanism assumption 1 holds.
- **Whole-package sweep**: each of the 1039 non-test source modules was taken as the first import of a fresh module graph under the flag. **22 threw.** 20 of them hit the `FilterConditionSchema` signature. The other 2 (`data/authoring-key-lint.ts`, `kernel/metadata-authoring-lint.ts`) threw `Cannot access 'FIELD_KEY_GUIDANCE' before initialization`, through `authoring-key-lint.ts` → `shared/suggestions.zod.ts` → `data/field.zod.ts`. That is the same edge.
- **`FieldType` in `suggestions.zod.ts`** is read only inside `suggestFieldType` (`FieldType.options`), so only when a suggestion is requested, never while the module loads. PM assumption 2 holds.
- **Who imports `suggestFieldType`**: `shared/error-map.zod.ts`, the root barrel (`src/index.ts`), `shared/index.ts` (`export *`), and two spec test files. Outside spec, `@objectstack/metadata-core` imports it from `@objectstack/spec/shared`.
- **PM assumption 3** holds only in part. `src/api/contract.zod.ts` and `src/data/filter.zod.ts` do crash as a first import, with the same signature. `scripts/lib/refinement-projection.ts` and `src/shared/refinement-projection.ts` do **not**: both exit 0 under the flag at `fdeeea0cc9` in both probe shapes (run as the entry, and a dynamic import from an ESM probe). No independent second cycle exists.

## The fix

The fix is the edge the loop closes on. `suggestFieldType` and its alias table move out of `shared/suggestions.zod.ts` into `shared/field-type-suggestion.ts`, which imports `data/field.zod` in one direction only. After the move, `suggestions.zod.ts` imports no schema module, and its header says why that must stay true. `shared/index.ts`, the root barrel and `error-map.zod.ts` import the function from its new home. **Public names are unchanged.** `suggestFieldType` is still exported from `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/spec/shared`, with the same signature and the same answers. `check:api-surface` reports "public API surface + factory signatures unchanged". `export-origins/` records the new declaration site for the two entries. `lazy-schema.ts` and `field.zod.ts` are untouched, so both named fences hold.

## Pin: `packages/spec/src/eager-entry-import.test.ts`

Every module subpath in spec's own `exports` map is mapped to its source entry, 17 today. Each entry is imported first in a fresh child process with `OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS=1` and must not throw. Two controls keep a green meaningful:

1. Under the flag, a known `lazySchema` export on `./data` (`FieldSchema`) and on `./api` (`ApiErrorSchema`) must arrive as a built zod object (`typeof` returns `object`). That proves the flag reached the child.
2. Without the flag, the same two entries must still import, and the export must stay the lazy Proxy (`typeof` returns `function`).

The pin covers source entries only. `@objectstack/spec#test` depends on `^build`, not on its own build, so `dist/` is not guaranteed to exist when the suite runs, and `check:test-source-alias` wants unit verdicts on source. The bundles were measured once, by hand (below).

## Evidence

- **Sweep after the fix**: 1040 modules, **0 threw**. All 17 source entries exit 0 under the flag in both probe shapes.
- **Dist, measured on the build of `fd9f55aad`** (`.build-input-hash` `60dad45334903e69`): all 44 published JS files (main and browser conditions, `.js` and `.mjs`, as listed in the `exports` map) exit 0 as a first import both with and without the flag. On the 8 `/data` and `/api` files the probe export reads `object` under the flag and `function` without it. The pre-fix dist was **not** re-measured here; the reading for it is the card's (`dist/data/index.js:1989`, `reading 'optional'`).
- **Ablation A** (re-close the edge): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` added `import { FieldType } from '../data/field.zod'` plus one use to `suggestions.zod.ts` (blob `4ed9b1d8` → `bb5a0192`, anchor 1 → 0). The pin went red on exactly `./data` and `./api` with the card's `ReferenceError`, and the other 18 cases stayed green. The restore was proven (blob == HEAD `4ed9b1d8`, `git diff HEAD` empty). My first attempt was refused by the tool (the replacement contained the anchor), so nothing ran on it; it was re-anchored and run as above.
- **Ablation B** (break the env hand-off in the test): control 1 went red on `./data` and `./api` (`FieldSchema was not built at import — the flag never took effect`), and the other 18 stayed green. The restore was proven (blob == HEAD `9e2b7b0f`).
- **Spec suites at `fd9f55aad`**: `vitest run --project local`: 527 files passed, 1 skipped (15521 tests passed). `--project repo`: 35 files passed (602 tests). `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` + `check:scripts-typecheck` + `check:test-typecheck`) exited 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists all four touched test and source files.
- **Gates**: `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 86 families on this diff. All were run at `fd9f55aad` and reconciled with `--ran` ("86 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 84 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED"). 82 exit 0, 2 exit 1 (the named gap below), and 2 were NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` both need every workspace package built and refused with exit 3 twice, so they are declared to CI's full build. Prerequisites were built for `check:api-surface`, `check:dual-source-exports`, `check:entry-nameability`, `check:exported-any`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:doc-formula-expressions` (turbo build of spec, formula, lint and objectql), and all six then exit 0. `check:generated`: 14 of 15 artifacts are current, and `check:nul-bytes` passes.

## Named gap: `check:skill-refs` is red, and a decision is needed

`gen:skill-refs` builds each skill's `references/_index.md` by walking the textual import closure of its core schemas. The removed edge was how `strict-object.ts` reached `data/field.zod.ts` and its subtree. Any fix inside the fences removes that edge, so the closure moves with it:

- `objectstack-i18n`: the generator **refuses**. Its `TRANSITIVE_ALLOWLIST` row (`scripts/lib/skill-map-guards.ts`) keeps `shared/identifiers.zod.ts` and `data/field.zod.ts`, and both were reachable only through this edge. The row's own docblock says no import edge expresses them; they are kept for what the i18n `SKILL.md` teaches (the snake_case "Critical:" rule, and option-value keys).
- If that is resolved, three published indexes would shrink. `objectstack-query` goes from 7 transitive pointers to 1, `objectstack-api` from 18 to 13, and `objectstack-automation` from 11 to 7. The pointers lost are field, field-value, expression, identifiers, value-domain, metadata-protection and, for automation, filter. Grep over those three skills' authored markdown (excluding the generated index) names none of them.

All four `_index.md` files live under `skills/**`, a Tier H governed surface. Whichever way this is resolved, landing this PR therefore needs the maintainer's word. The options, costs and a recommendation are in the `os-dev-report` on #19930. **No speculative change is made here.**

## Acceptance notes (noted, not filed)

- Several comments still describe the removed edge in the present tense. The defensive code under them (hoisted functions, deferred error maps, lazily built sets) stays valid and is not removed here. The sites are the `shared/strict-object.ts` docblocks around `declarationStore`, `strictObjectError`, `PrimableErrorMap` and `closedObjectConstructor`; `shared/strict-object.test.ts` (the eager-construction block); `data/field-value.zod.ts:35`; `data/field.zod.ts:184`, which is fenced by the PR holding that file; and `scripts/lib/skill-map-guards.ts:200`. Carrier: none.
- The first-import crash reported for the two `refinement-projection` modules did not reproduce at `fdeeea0cc9` (see above).

## Contract review

No accept or reject result changes, and the public export surface is byte-identical per `check:api-surface`. Only the declaration site of one function moves, so a contract review is not owed on this diff as it stands.
